step: S1 — owner-only cost predicates (0177), owner decision 2

probes.note: A bare `margin` is not forbidden here (a layout word could carry it); the print-service rates are, by name: since DECISIONS row 220 printServicePricing is no longer a public setting, so its margin_percent, setup_fee_iqd and machine_iqd_per_hour must never reach the home payload.

note: Anonymous GETs only (master plan §4.0). Key regexes are critique A9's; `pricing_mode` is anchored so the public `pricing_modes` (sale modes on a product page) is not mistaken for the private engine flag. A bare `rule_id` is NOT forbidden: the product page's `membership_preview.pro.rule_id` names the public PRO/PRIME discount rule a customer is shown, not a cost, and once PRO is resumed every product page carries it. The cost-rule ids (`target_rule_id`, `extra_rule_id` and its old name `premium_rule_id`, adminScope FINANCIAL_FIELDS) are forbidden by name. CATALOG-ONLY (DECISIONS rows 239-240; Bambu import spec §K.1 D-1): a product is SHOWN before it has a price, so a listing or a page may mix priced and unpriced products. `{slug}` is read from the listing filtered by a price range (`price=1-`, packages/catalog/src/discovery.ts formatPriceRange), which excludes every unpriced product (R3), so the page probed is a priced one (`expectValues`); the listing and the page carry `price_iqd` under `requirePriceKeys`: an integer, or null only on an object marked `price_status: unpriced`, never a number on one. The listing probe requires its prices only while {slug} has a value (`requireWhenVar`): right after the clean-start cut-over nothing is priced until the first V2 publish (DECISIONS row 222); its forbidden keys still hold, and any price it does show follows the price rule. A listing that cannot be read is a failure, never an empty catalogue.
